item.title: Tandem Diabetes Care, Inc.: Tandem Mobi Insulin Pump, Models: 1004004, 1010750, 1012676, 1012719, 1013655, 1013656, 1013501, 1013700, 1014081, 1014801, 1014811, 1014813 Recall
item.summary: Tandem Diabetes Care, Inc. ( Tandem ) has identified that certain Tandem Mobi insulin pumps may generate false-positive occlusion alarms when no actual insulin flow obstruction is present. Investigation determined that increased friction within the drive module can reduce available motor power and, under certain conditions, cause motor speed to fall below the occlusion detection threshold. As a result, the pump may incorrectly detect an occlusion condition and suspend insulin delivery. When an occlusion alarm occurs, insulin delivery remains suspended until the user acknowledges the alarm and resumes therapy. Repeated false-positive occlusion alarms, if not addressed promptly, may result in interruptions of insulin delivery that can increase the risk of elevated blood glucose levels. In severe cases, hyperglycemia may require medical intervention or hospitalization.
